title: Ada confronts the empty control room
narrativeProgression: Ada enters confidently, recognizes deliberate abandonment, and chooses to investigate.
lookbookInfluence: Cold institutional surfaces and restrained practical light.

beats.title: The room answers with absence
beats.description: Ada stands just inside the empty control room. Dormant consoles surround her, the far doorway remains dark, and a lone status light makes the silence feel deliberate.
beats.narrativeDevelopment: Ada enters expecting a response and realizes the room has been abandoned.
beats.narrativePurpose: Turn anticipation into unease and establish the absence as meaningful.
